sentences.text: No, the documents do not state that the May 7, 2014 circular is the current rule today, because it was superseded in the 2025 directions and the 2025 directions were later withdrawn with immediate effect. [core=true]

The 2014 circular said that banks “will not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges/ pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers, with immediate effect.”

That 2014 circular was addressed to “All Scheduled Commercial Banks (Excluding RRBs),” so the documents do not state that it is the current rule for Example UCB (fictional) · Tier 3 UCB today. [core=true]

missing.searched: May 2014 foreclosure-charges circular as a current rule for Example UCB (fictional) · Tier 3 UCB on 2026-11-23
